name: Tenoch
contribution: A ruler of the Mexica in the 14th century during the Aztec travels from Aztlán to Tenochtitlan.

checks.lead: Tenoch (or Tenuch, ) was a ruler of the Mexica (Aztecas) in the 14th century during the Aztec travels from Aztlán to Tenochtitlan. The settlers of Tenochtitlan were originally referred to as Tenochca, then the Mexica. Tenoch was a respected chief who was elected to power by the council of elders and died sometime between 1350 and 1375, depending on the source.
